Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei Buried Amid US Strikes and Regional Tensions

Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was buried in his hometown of Mashhad following funeral processions in Iraq. The events occurred amidst renewed US strikes on Iran and Iran's subsequent warnings of retaliation, including alleged missile and drone attacks on US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Tensions in the Gulf region have escalated, with a high alert issued.
